content.text: {"decision": "explain", "likely_cause": "Likely cause: On the \"ir swap:screen\" form, a visible error event fires on the Counterparty input within about 5 ms of focus (focus 61 at 3224 ms, error 62:a64 at 3229 ms), before any typing in that field, and the user then types in Counterparty (68), moves to Notional (79), and leaves via the Static Data menu to \"counterparty:screen\" (92, app:13), so the form is left unsaved.", "fix": "Fix: On the \"ir swap:screen\" form, change the Counterparty input so its validation message is shown only after blur or submit (not on focus), and add an inline \"Find or create counterparty\" link beside the Counterparty field that opens Static Data in a new tab so the unsaved IR swap form is preserved.", "cited_event_ids": ["61", "62:a64", "67", "68", "79", "92", "app:13"], "confidence": "med", "unsupported": ["The text and rule of the error event 62:a64 are not in the events, so the validation cause is inferred from timing only.", "The window does not show why the user navigated to Static Data; the link to counterparty setup is a hypothesis.", "The insight says the form was abandoned without saving, but session S8c531a3d shows a later app_action success (app:15:success at 7929 ms) and the second session also shows saves; the windows end at about 22.9 s, so the abandonment point is not visible.", "Session S863594b4 shows errors on Trade Date (50:a51, 54:a56), not on Counterparty, so the Counterparty-specific cause is supported by only one of the two windows.", "The coverage list is empty and 123 and 134 pointer samples were dropped, so pointer-level detail is incomplete."]}
